versions.changelog: Fix manifest updateUrl: now points at Thetanuts-Finance/thetanuts-openclaw (canonical) and the correct filename scripts/update.sh. v1.5.3 had both wrong org (legacy fork) and wrong filename (update-from-manifest.sh — does not exist), making manifest-driven updates 404. No skill code or SDK changes vs 1.5.3.

Bump @thetanuts-finance/thetanuts-client to 0.2.4. New client.collar module (pricing only; coordinator pending deployment), payable client.option.reclaimCollateral & client.loan.splitOption wrappers that auto-forward on-chain fees, deprecated zero-arg payout() (r12 settles automatically via notifyTradeSettled), trimmed referral/admin surface on optionFactory, removed VaultModule.trigger(). Skill scripts unaffected. See PR #3.

thetanuts v1.5.2

- Updated onboarding instructions and option structure documentation in SKILL.md and README.md.
- Minor adjustments to code organization in scripts/lib/load-seed.ts.
- No user-facing feature or API changes; primarily documentation and internal structure updates.

thetanuts v1.5.1

- Updated documentation (README.md, CLAUDE.md) for clarity and accuracy.
- Minor manifest.json refinements; no breaking changes.
- Small script update to scripts/approve-token.ts with minor improvements.
- No functional changes to protocol or onboarding logic.

- Startup update check is no longer automatic; code updates now require explicit user approval.
- Onboarding flow now runs only safe, read-only wallet status checks automatically.
- Users must manually trigger update.sh, and are shown the output before any code changes.
- Security and wallet onboarding steps are unchanged, but update handling is now more cautious.

Thetanuts Skill 1.4.0

- Added a new CLAUDE.md file to the repository.
- Updated onboarding and security guidance in SKILL.md.
- Improved and clarified step-by-step onboarding instructions and startup checks in documentation.
- Enhanced package scripts (build-rfq.ts, fill-order.ts, onboard.sh) for improved reliability.
- Updated package dependency versions in package.json and package-lock.json.
- Documentation refinements for usage, setup, and security reminders.
